title: Coaugmentation equation for the strict perfect-coefficient exchange
statement:
Let $S,T,X,Y$ be small ringed sites with a commutative square of ringed topoi $f:X\to S$, $g:T\to S$, $h:Y\to X$, $e:Y\to T$ and a specified ring-compatible isomorphism $fh\cong ge$ [def-weil-size-convention]. Assume all four coefficient pullbacks are isomorphisms, so module inverse images $L_u$ are exact, and use their canonical unbounded adjunctions $L_u\dashv R_u=Ru_*$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. On $S$ fix a strict inverse sequence $Q_{S,\bullet}$ of complexes of coefficient modules, a strict augmentation $\Delta\mathcal O_S[0]\to Q_{S,\bullet}$, and assume every $Q_{S,n}$ is perfect, meaning locally quasi-isomorphic to a bounded complex of direct summands of finite sums of $\mathcal O_S$. Pull this diagram to all other corners with the specified coefficient and square comparisons. On the small diagram sites [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization] let $\mathcal R_W(M)=\Delta M\otimes^L Q_{W,\bullet}$, $\mathcal L_W=R\lim$, $C_W=\mathcal L_W\mathcal R_W$, and let $\kappa_{W,M}:M\to C_WM$ be the strict-augmentation map followed by derived inverse limit. Use the canonical constant-tower and evaluation comparisons preserving the ordinary derived adjunctions. They are the comparisons computed on K-injective towers, not choices of unrelated component isomorphisms.
For any $K\in D(\mathcal O_T)$ put $M=L_fR_gK$, $E=L_eK$, $N=R_hE$, and let $b:M\to N$ be the ordinary square mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Write $\mathscr L_u,\mathscr R_u$ for derived termwise inverse/direct image on the diagram sites, and put
$$B=\mathscr L_f\mathscr R_g\mathcal R_TK,\qquad D=\mathscr R_h\mathscr L_e\mathcal R_TK.$$
Let $H:\mathcal R_XM\to B$ and $H':\mathcal R_XN\to D$ be the projection-formula maps, meaning adjuncts of counit tensored with identity, including canonical pullback/tensor reassociation [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-map]. These are invertible. Define
$$v=H'\mathcal R_X(b)H^{-1},\quad s=\mathcal L_XH:C_XM\to\mathcal L_XB,\quad c:R_hC_YE\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal L_XD,$$
where $c$ is the canonical derived-direct-image/derived-limit comparison whose projections are direct images of the tower projections. Then the natural morphism $\gamma_K=c^{-1}\mathcal L_X(v)s$ satisfies
$$\gamma_K\kappa_{X,M}=R_h(\kappa_{Y,E})b.$$
Moreover $v$ is the actual diagram-site square mate on $\mathcal R_TK$, and its evaluation at $n$ is the $Q_n$-tensor square mate under the indicated comparisons. If the $Q_{W,n}$ are quotient ring sheaves in degree zero, this is the ordinary quotient-ring coefficient mate after restriction of scalars. These are equations of strict derived-tower morphisms and their derived limits. No completeness of $K$, reflector property of $C_W$, cartesianness or geometric finiteness is assumed.
